title: Almaty PM2.5 / PM10 spatiotemporal modelling — reproducibility package
description: Reproducibility package (code, hash-locked derived data, and verification scripts) for the manuscript 'Spatiotemporal Modelling of PM2.5 and PM10 in Almaty: Leakage-Controlled Forecasting, GIS Predictors, and Geographically Weighted Regression'. Does not include the manuscript text or raw third-party GIS/ERA5 source files; see README.md.
